The CNN Money Fear and Greed index showed an improvement in the overall market sentiment, while the index remained in the “Fear” zone on Thursday.



U.S. stocks settled higher on Thursday, with the Nasdaq Composite surging almost 500 points during the session, led by a sharp rally in semiconductors, as a signed U.S.-Iran peace deal sent oil tumbling.

items.title: Asia Is Going All-In On AI Stocks — And Leveraged Demand Is Breaking Records: Here's What You Should Know
items.body:
Leverage tied to artificial intelligence stocks is reaching record highs in Asia, with a fund linked to SK Hynix growing to $13 billion and becoming Hong Kong’s second-largest ETF, according to The Kobeissi Letter.



Assets Triple In Two Months



Assets under management in the Hong Kong-listed fund, CSOP SK Hynix Daily (2x) Leveraged Product, have more than tripled over the past two months
